defect_observations.observation: Scope swap in the symbol registry. Rows 1587-1590 hold this chapter's notation (X, A, Y, H, f, h, P, S, V(S); R_P(h,f), hat R_S(h), m, r, epsilon, delta; C, ell(h), L, n, c, a, q; b(S), b_+(S), w_h, H_L, t_h) but are scoped 'P15 fisher-estimation' / sec:p15-fisher-estimation. Rows 1602-1606 hold confidence-construction notation (A_j^U, I_j^U, D_2, D_3, Q_I, z_alpha, ...) and are scoped 'P15 occam-learning' / sec:p15-occam-learning. The generated symbol index therefore sends occam notation to the Fisher chapter (handbook/generated/symbol-index.tex lines 929, 9559) and confidence notation to this chapter (lines 522, 738, 7260, 8392, 8413). Lookup apparatus; not scored as a component verdict.

The learning task-finder case (sec:p14-finder-learning) routes only to sec:p15-bounded-concentration-learning. No task-finder case reaches sec:p15-occam-learning (realizable consistent learning, description-length counting, the weighted countable-class bound), and the queue destination records lookup.final_subject_task_cases_pending = true. This is a unit-level lookup obligation, outside the twelve component verdicts.

The annex files input after annex/p15/occam-learning (rissanen-structural-and-numerical-inference, vc-dimension-and-uniform-learning, formal-learning-and-identification, primitive-recursive-learning-obstructions) begin with annexitem and have no section heading. Their proof items therefore print under 'Consistent learning and description length: complete proofs' (sec:annex-p15-occam-learning, annex/p15/occam-learning.tex lines 1-2). Annex navigation only.

Statement ellipsis. thm:p15-occam-compression does not state inside the theorem that the target satisfies ell(f) <= n or that the guarantee is uniform in P; the definition (lines 127-130) and the annex proof (annex line 114) supply both. The first paragraph of thm:p15-occam-minimum-approximation (lines 167-175) names neither the learner (a proper consistent learner with a = 0) nor what the sample size is required for (error at most epsilon with probability at least 1-delta); context and annex lines 178-186 supply them. Not scored as an unstated assumption, because the hypotheses appear at the cited definition and proof lines.

The title promises a guarantee for the selected hypothesis. The statement gives the simultaneous bound over V(S) but never writes the one-line consequence for a proper consistent learner's output. Credited, because the selected output lies in V(S) on the same event, which annex lines 204-208 make explicit for every consistent hypothesis.

The order-of-magnitude step says only 'bounded by a constant multiple of' and does not show the constant (for example max{2, (2 ln 2)^(1/(1-a))}). The body's claim that the constants depend only on c and a (lines 162-163) is therefore stated without the constant being displayed. The computation is elementary and is not scored.

The source's alpha = 0 order O((1/epsilon)(n^c + ln(1/delta))) (held PDF p.4 = IPL p.380) is not written. It follows from the explicit bound through q >= epsilon (annex lines 29-32), but that step is not stated. The source's remark on the same page comparing Pearl's sample sizes (epsilon replaced by its square) is not reproduced; it lies outside the cited Lemma 2.1 / Definition 2.2 / Theorem 2.3 extent.
The wording is duplicated: 'assume that testing one represented hypothesis on one encoded observation is assumed to take polynomial time'.
The empirical error hat R_S(h) is defined but never used in the chapter.
